title: Converse of Proportion Theorem
text:
**Converse of Proportion Theorem:**

If a line divides two sides of a triangle in the same ratio, then that line is parallel to the third side.

title: Calculate First Ratio
text:
$$\frac{KP}{PL} = \frac{6}{9} = \frac{2}{3}$$

What is 6 divided by 9 (to 3 decimal places)?

title: Calculate Second Ratio
text:
$$\frac{KQ}{QM} = \frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}$$

What is 8 divided by 12 (to 3 decimal places)?

title: Conclusion
text:
Since $$\frac{KP}{PL} = \frac{KQ}{QM} = \frac{2}{3}$$

By the converse of the proportion theorem, **PQ || LM**.
